**Verdict: not built - needs a maintainer look.** The read is clean. Nothing was executed by this review: the PR is from an outside contributor, so no build ran here and the runner refuses it. A maintainer decides when to build it.

## What looks good

- The Prime Directive holds: a unitless STEP file is refused by name (`StepError::MissingUnits` / `ImportError::StepUnitsMissing`), never read in a guessed unit. The refusal text names the fix (`crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`, `crates/geometry/src/step.rs`).
- The unit goes into the file's representation contexts before the read (`crates/kernel/src/step_assumed_unit.rs`), so the tolerance, the edge-gap cap and the chord stay in the unit of the geometry. The range check (0.001..=1000 mm, finite) and the id overflow guard are clean.
- "Everything Is a Command" holds: the prompt is view state, the answer goes through `CommandKind::ResolveStepUnits`, and the import that lands is the one undoable command. Cancel and Escape import nothing.
- The MCP and script surface came with the command: `import_model` takes `units`, `cam.import` takes the fourth argument, and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` plus `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts` were regenerated in step.
- The added `unwrap`/`expect` calls are all in tests. Provenance lines are present on every new module. The decision record `docs/decisions/1874-step-length-units.md` states the choices, the reasons and what was dropped.
- The updated tests assert the exact unit-note text; no assertion is weaker.
- No dependency, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `Cargo.toml`, `CHANGELOG.md`, golden or snapshot change is in the diff. The PR body is complete: `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1874`; the commit subject is conventional.

## Results

- **Not built - read-only review (outside contributor).** No worktree build, no test run, no clippy by this review.
- GitHub reports the head MERGEABLE with `main`.
- The author reports: quick gate green on 2649bb17e except `ai_guide_calls_match_live_tools_list`, clippy clean for the four crates. That one red step is the known Windows CRLF defect, open issue #3119; it is not caused by this PR.

## Heavy lanes

- The diff touches `kernel`, `geometry` and `app`, so it reaches `kernel heavy`, `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. The author reports a green run of all three on head 2649bb17e (253 steps, 0 failed). This review did not run them and cannot confirm that result. Whoever builds this must run the light lane and those three heavy steps on the final head before merge.

## Requested before merge

- None from the read. The blocker to merge is only the missing independent build.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `unit_note` joins every context's unit by name. A multi-representation file that states no unit gets the caller's unit in each context, so the note can read `length unit: mm, mm`. One name would read better. (`crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs`, `unit_note`.)
- `State::step_units_next` holds the chosen unit keyed by path until it is taken. If the user answers the prompt and then imports a different file first, the unit waits and applies to a later import of that path. A clear on any other import start would close the window. (`crates/ui/src/state_step_units.rs`.)
- No screenshot of the new modal yet. A UI PR normally carries before/after images in its body.
- `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` (512 lines) and `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (405 lines) were already over 400; this PR adds 8 and 5 lines. Not a reason to hold the PR.
- A linked-file re-import of a unitless STEP asks again, by the recorded decision. That is correct, and worth one line in the troubleshooting entry if users hit it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b5637db2ba4877befb43abf88c6203360ba00928 -->

**Read clean, not built.** This review executed nothing: the PR is from a fork, so no build ran here and the PR test runner refuses it. The new head fixes both items of the earlier change request, on the read. @mkinney (or another collaborator) should re-check: the Linux/macOS build of `cadmpeg_import` and clippy that his item 1 asked for has still not run anywhere.

## What looks good

- The fix commit `b5637db2b` gives `, None` as the fourth argument at all eight `cadmpeg::load_open_within` calls in `crates/app/tests/cadmpeg_import.rs` (lines 118, 127, 147, 156, 171, 178, 183, 273). The `#[cfg(unix)]` module now matches the new signature.
- `State::take_step_units` (`crates/ui/src/state_step_units.rs:48`) now takes the choice on every import start, whatever its file, so a chosen unit never waits for a later import of the same path. `begin_import` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:4350`) is the single call site, so every import clears it. Pinned by `a_chosen_unit_never_waits_for_a_later_import_of_the_same_file`.
- `troubleshooting.md` now says the answer is not kept and that a linked file's re-import asks again.
- The `length unit: mm, mm` note from the earlier review cannot occur: `step_length_units::read` keeps each distinct value once (`crates/kernel/src/step_length_units.rs`, the `to_bits` dedup). The contributor's explanation holds on the read.
- Nothing else changed since head `2649bb17e`, which two collaborator reviews read closely. The laws hold at this head as they did there: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests (all added ones are in test files), the unitless refusal is by name (`ImportError::StepUnitsMissing`), the answer goes through the command queue and the import that lands is one undoable command, provenance lines are on every new module, and the new test files sit in the crates they cover with Gate map headers.
- No `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, top-level `scripts/`, golden or snapshot-PNG change is in the diff. Body process lines are complete: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #1874`, conventional commit subjects. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (already over 400 lines) grew by 2 lines in the fix commit.

## Results

- **Not built.** Read-only review of an outside contributor's PR: no local build slot, and the self-hosted runner must not run fork code. No tests and no clippy ran in this review.
- Trial merge with `main` `5e76e6a14`: clean (`git merge-tree`, no conflicts). GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3166 --reviewed 2649bb17e`: class NEW CODE (one hand-edit commit), so this head needed a full read - done.
- The fix commit did not change `crates/kernel`, `crates/geometry` or `crates/app/src`, so the earlier reviews' readings of that code still apply.

## Heavy lanes

- The diff reaches `kernel heavy`, `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. The author reports 253 steps ok, 0 failed on this head `b5637db2b` (Windows x86_64). This review did not run them and cannot confirm that result.

## Requested before merge

1. **A Linux or macOS build of `crates/app/tests/cadmpeg_import.rs` and clippy.** The eight fixes are in the `#[cfg(unix)]` module; no reported gate compiles it (Windows). This was item 1 of @mkinney's change request and is the one reading the fix commit could not show on its own.
2. **Label: `needs-rework` stays until @mkinney re-checks.** Both of his items read as addressed at this head (the `None` arguments, and a Screenshot section in the body since 15:20 UTC), but I will not remove another collaborator's change request. The contributor kept the screenshot as a GitHub upload instead of the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch; the content he asked for is in the body.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `ResolveStepUnits` is dispatched like `ResolveUnsaved` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:3441`): view state plus one undoable import. That fits "Everything Is a Command".
- `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts` and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` changed. They are regenerated surface files, not executed build code; this review only read them.
- The maintainer still owns the decision on the ask-on-import dialog itself (why `needs-maintainer` stays).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
